title: Extend an eventual strip bound using translation periodicity
statement: Let N∈ℕ with N≠0 and q:ℍ→ℂ. Assume q(T^Nτ)=q(τ) for every τ∈ℍ, where T=(1 1;0 1). Suppose there exist M,Y∈ℝ such that |q(τ)|≤M whenever 0≤Re τ≤N and Im τ≥Y. Then q is bounded at imaginary infinity in the sense of UpperHalfPlane.IsBoundedAtImInfty.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : UpperHalfPlane → ℂ), (∀ τ : UpperHalfPlane, q ((ModularGroup.T ^ N) • τ) = q τ) → (∃ M Y : ℝ, ∀ τ : UpperHalfPlane, 0 ≤ τ.re → τ.re ≤ (N : ℝ) → Y ≤ τ.im → ‖q τ‖ ≤ M) → UpperHalfPlane.IsBoundedAtImInfty q
